tsha shrī //bka' ra// ༄(17)krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

'bum/ 9mi (17)0025 shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ ldabacu gnyis pa/ zil gyis gnon pa'i le'u/(smad) 3bcu gsum pa/ gnyis su med pa'i le'u/ 388bcu bzhi pa/ rab 'byor gyi le'u/ 633bco lnga pa/ brgya byin gyi le'u/(stod) 807bsdur mchan/(846) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(874):dkar ga gi zur ma na/ chos tshan (0025)pa'i le'u'i mtshan mi gsal ba rnams bstan 'gyur dpe bsdur ma'i deb nga gsum pa'i chos tshan (3027)pa gzhir gzung ste bsgrigs shing / ma yig tu le'u bcu gsum pa rab 'byor gyi le'ur byas yod na yang / 'dir rgya 'grel gnyis dang bstun nas bcu gsum pa gnyis su med pa'i le'u dang bcu bzhi pa rab 'byor gyi le'ur byas te bsgrigs yod/

༄ga /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/①༄༅༅/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ glegs bam bzhi pa/② bam po dang poni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa 0ti'i bu/dran pa nye bar gzhag ⑤pa myed 0pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid kyi ⑦phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi 17—3

dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa myed pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi ①dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa myed pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dben pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa myed pa yang ②gzhan ma yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin / sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa myed pa gang yin pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dben pa gang yin pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su 17—4

skyed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ yang dag par spong ba myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//yang dag par spong ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ yang dag par spong ba myed pa dang / yang dag par spong ba stong pa nyid dang / yang dag par spong ba dben pa dang / yang dag par spong ba ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ yang dag par spong ba myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ yang dag par spong ba stong pa nyid kyang 17—5

gzhan ma yin/ yang dag par spong ba dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ yang dag par spong ba ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na/ yang dag par spong ba myed pa gang yin pa dang / yang dag par spong ba stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dben pa gang yin pa dang / yang dag par spong ba ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /17—6

rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyid dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa gang yin pa dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dben pa gang yin pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de ①thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/dbang po myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi 17—7

mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi ①dmyigs so/ /dbang po ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//dbang po dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dbang po myed pa dang / dbang po stong pa nyid dang / dbang po dben pa dang /dbang po ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs②ske/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ dbang po myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/dbang po stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ dbang po dben pa yang gzhan ma yin / dbang po ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na dbang po myed pa gang yin pa dang / dbang po stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / dbang po dben pa gang yin pa dang / dbang po ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /17—8

sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su skyed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ stobs myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /stobs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /stobs dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /stobs myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /stobs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /stobs dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar ①phyi dmyigs so/ /stobs myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /stobs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /stobs dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ stobs myed pa dang /stobs stong pa nyid dang / stobs dben pa dang / stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stobs myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ stobs stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ stobs dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' 17—9

yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na stobs myed pa gang yin pa dang / stobs stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / stobs dben pa gang yin pa dang / stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag ngo bo 17—10

nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag stong pa nyid dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / de ltar na byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/17—11

byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong pa nyid dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dben pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ngo bo nyid skyed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang 17—12

gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa gang yin pa dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dben pa gang yin pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'phags pa'i bden pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su 17—13

smon pa myed pa ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon ①gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin②/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed pa gang yin pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dben pa gang yin pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ②ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mngon par shes pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /mngon 17—24

par shes pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mngon par shes pa skyed pa dang /mngon par shes pa stong pa nyid dang / mngon par shes pa dben pa dang /mngon par shes pa ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mngon par shes pa myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ mngon par shes pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ mngon par shes pa dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ mngon par shes pa ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na mngon par shes pa myed pa gang yin pa dang / mngon par shes pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /mngon par shes pa dben pa gang yin pa dang / mngon par shes pa ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de ①thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ting nge 'dzin skyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems 17—25

dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin skyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ting nge 'dzin myed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin stong pa nyid dang /ting nge 'dzin dben pa dang / ting nge 'dzin ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ting nge 'dzin skyed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin / sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/17—26

dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na ting nge 'dzin myed pa gang yin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dben pa gang yin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de ①thams cad kyang gnyis su skyed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzungs kyi sgo myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra 17—27

dwa ti'i bu/ gzungs kyi sgo myed pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo stong pa nyid dang /gzungs kyi sgo dben pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo ngo bo nyid myed pa la ①sdon gyi mtha' ②kyi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' ①phyi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/gzungs kyi sgo myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ gzungs kyi sgo stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ gzungs kyi sgo dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ gzungs kyi sgo ngo bo nyid med pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin / sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na gzungs kyi sgo myed pa gang yin pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo dben pa gang yin pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i byamatha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs myed pa'i phyir⑤/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi 17—28

ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs stong pa nyid kyi phyir / byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan ①pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs myed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs stong pa nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dben pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' mi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs myed pa gang yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dben pa gang yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 17—29

stobs ngo bo nyid skyed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang /dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myi 'jigs pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /mi 'jigs pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /mi 'jigs pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir ①zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myi 'jigs pa myed pa dang / myi 'jigs pa stong pa nyid dang /mi 'jigs pa dben pa dang / mi 'jigs pa ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ myi 17—30

'jigs pa myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ myi 'jigs pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ mi 'jigs pa dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ mi 'jigs pa ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na myi 'jigs pa myed pa gang yin pa dang / myi 'jigs pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / myi 'jigs pa dben pa gang yin pa dang / myi 'jigs pa ngo bo nyid myed pa ①gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ so so yang dag par rig pa myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /17—31

so so yang dag par rig pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa dben pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ so so yang dag par rig pa myed pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa stong pa nyid dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dben pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa ngo bo nyid med pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus mi dmyigs te/ so so yang dag par rig pa skyed pa yang gzhan ma yin/so so yang dag par rig pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa ngo bo nyid med pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na so so yang dag par rig pa myed pa gang yin pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dben pa gang yin pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang /phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ snying rje 17—32

chen po myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' stisdon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po med pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ snying rje chen po myed pa dang / snying rje chen po stong pa nyid dang / snying rje chen po dben pa dang / snying rje chen po ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus mi dmyigs te/ snying rje chen po myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ snying rje chen po stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ snying rje chen po dben pa yang gzhan ma yin / snying rje chen po ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi 17—33

ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na snying rje chen po myed pa gang yin pa dang /snying rje chen po stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / snying rje chen po dben pa gang yin pa dang / snying rje chen po ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa myed pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres 17—34

pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa myed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa stong pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dben pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' ①mi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang ②gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa myed pa gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dben pa gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i ③bu/ gzhan yang chos kyi dbyings myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs 17—35

sol/ /chos kyi dbyings dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar yimyi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs sol/ /chos kyi dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings dben pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /chos kyi dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ chos kyi dbyings myed pa dang / chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dben pa dang /chos kyi dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' mi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ chos kyi dbyings myed pa yang gzhan ma yin / chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ chos kyi dbyings dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ chos kyi dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin / byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na chos kyi dbyings myed pa 17—36

gang yin pa dang / chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / chos kyi dbyings dben pa gang yin pa dang / chos kyi dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang de bzhin nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin nyid dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin nyid ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin nyid dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin nyid ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//de bzhin nyid dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so//de bzhin nyid ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin nyid myed pa dang / de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid 17—37

dben pa dang / de bzhin nyid ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus ①kyi dmyigs te/ de bzhin nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma ②yin/ de bzhin nyid dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ de bzhin nyid ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na de bzhin nyid med pa gang yin pa dang / de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / de bzhin nyid dben pa gang yin pa dang / de bzhin nyid ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang yang dag pa'i mtha' myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs sol/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi 17—38

dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/yang dag pa'i mtha' myed pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' stong pa nyid dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dben pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/yang dag pa'i mtha' myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ yang dag pa'i mtha' stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ yang dag pa'i mtha' dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/yang dag pa'i mtha' ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na yang dag pa'i mtha' myed pa gang yin pa dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dben pa gang yin pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i 17—39

bum/ gzhan yang bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so / /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings stong pa nyid kyi ①phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings dben ②pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmigs so/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings myed pa dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings stong pa nyid dang /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings dben pa dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi 17—40

dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang ①gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings myed pa gang yin pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings dben pa gang yin pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang nyan thos myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /nyan thos stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /nyan thos dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /nyan thos ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs sosri/ /nyan thos myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /nyan thos stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /nyan thos dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /nyan thos ngo bo nyid myed 17—41

pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /nyan thos myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /nyan thos stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /nyan thos dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /nyan thos ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nyan thos myed pa dang / nyan thos stong pa nyid dang / nyan thos dben pa dang /nyan thos ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' mi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs te/ nyan thos myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/nyan thos stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ nyan thos dben pa yang gzhan ma yin / nyan thos ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na nyan thos myed pa gang yin pa dang / nyan thos stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / nyan thos dben pa gang yin pa dang / nyan thos ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de ①gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang rang sangs rgyas myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rang 17—42

sangs rgyas dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas stong pa nyid kyi phyir / byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su ①phyi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rang sangs rgyas myed pa dang /rang sangs rgyas stong pa nyid dang / rang sangs rgyas dben pa dang / rang sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ rang sangs rgyas myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/rang sangs rgyas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ rang sangs rgyas dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ rang sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na rang sangs rgyas myed pa gang yin pa dang /17—43

rang sangs rgyas stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dben pa gang yin pa dang / rang sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//byang chub sems dpa' myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so//byang chub sems dpa' ②skyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' 17—44

myed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa' dben pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' ①phyi dmyigs②/ phyi ma'i mtha' ②phyi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/byang chub sems dpa' myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/byang chub sems dpa' ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' med pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dben pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / gzhan yang thams cad mkhyen pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa rjodaben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ⑤ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmigs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa skyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa stong pa nyid 17—45

kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so//thams cad mkhyen pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ②skyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir / byang chub sems dpa' dbus su mi dmyigs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/thams cad mkhyen pa myed pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa stong pa nyid dang /thams cad mkhyen pa dben pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/thams cad mkhyen pa myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ thams cad mkhyen pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ thams cad mkhyen pa dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/thams cad mkhyen pa ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na thams cad mkhyen pa ②skyed pa gang yin pa dang /thams cad mkhyen pa ③stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dudaben pa gang yin pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dungo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin 17—46

pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / rnam grangs des na byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so// //①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po gnyis phyapa/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gang yang 'di skad du/ geci'i phyir rgyan/gzugs kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar ⑤dper na nam mkha' la ni/ sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du gzugs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ gzugs kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am/ dbus myi dmyigs so sgye/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na gzugs kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du / ci'i phyir na/ tshor ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ tshor ba ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/17—47

'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du tshor ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ tshor ba'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so37/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ tshor ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du/ ci'i phyir na/'du shes kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ②ti'i bu/ 'du shes ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du 'du shes stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'du shes kyi dusngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus mi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs socho/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/'du shes kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du/ ci'i phyir na/ 'du byed kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'du byed ni 17—48

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na/nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du 'du byed stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'du byed kyi lasngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus mi dmyigs sol/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/'du byed kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du/ ci'i phyir na/ rnam par shes pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par shes pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na/ nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du rnam par shes pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ rnam par shes pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rnam par shes pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du/ ci'i phyir na/ myig kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub 17—49

sems dpa'/ kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myig ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na/ nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du mig stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ myig gi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ myig kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du/ ci'i phyir na/ rna ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rna ba ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na/nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du rna ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ rna ba'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rna ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du/ ci'i phyir ①na/ sna kun tu mtha' 17—50

sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par shes pa'i khams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i khams stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/rnam par shes pa'i khams kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ma rig pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ma rig pa ni ①nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du ma rig pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ ma rig pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ ma rig pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' 17—69

des na/ rnam par shes pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ mying dang gzugs kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mying dang gzugs ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du mying dang gzugs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ mying dang gzugs kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ mying dang gzugs kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ skye mched drug kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ skye mched drug ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du skye mched drug stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ skye mched drug gi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus 17—71

myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ skye mched drug kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ reg pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ reg pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du reg pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ reg pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ reg pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na / tshor ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/tshor ba ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du tshor ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ tshor ba'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi 17—72

dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ tshor ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ sred pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sred pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du sred pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/sred pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ sred pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i ①phyir / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ len pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ len pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du len pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ len pa'i sngon gyi mtha' 17—73

myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmigs sa/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ len pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na / srid pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/srid pa ①ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du srid pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ srid pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ srid pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ skye ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ skye ba ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du skye ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ skye 17—74

ba'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ skye ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ rga shi kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rga shi ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du rga shi stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ rga shi'i ༅sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/rga shi kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes snying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de 17—75

bzhin du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o / /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i ①bu/ de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/17—76

'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus mi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas ①pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir 17—77

na / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ①mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir ②na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/17—78

stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / rnam grangs des na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po gsum ①pa/gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ nang stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du nang stong pa nyid ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir / nang stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ nang stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ phyi stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ phyi stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' 17—79

zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du phyi stong pa nyid ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ phyi stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na / phyi nang stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na/ nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du phyi nang stong pa nyid ②stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ stong pa nyid ③stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar 17—80

dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ①kyi phyir/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' ②kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ chen po stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ chen po stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du chen po stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ①kyi phyir/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ chen po stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun 17—81
