tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/don dam pa stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar dper na/ nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du don dam pa stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ①kyi phyir/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o / /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du 'dus byas stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ②kyi phyir/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigasal/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/17—82

byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ①kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'dus ma ②byas stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na rgyanam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 0kyi phyir/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ⑤kyi phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' 17—83

myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i ①bu/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ②kyi phyir/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun sita mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi 17—84

dmyigs / phyi ①ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ②kyi phyir/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du rang bzhin stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dukyi phyir/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas 17—85

par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du chos thams cad stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ༅kyi phyir/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ②kyi phyir/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rang 17—86

gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na/ nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te phopho/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ②ti'i bu/ de bzhin du myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid stong pa nyid zhukyi phyir/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid stong 17—87

pa nyid ①kyi phyir/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ②'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ②kyi phyir / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni 17—88

sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ①kyi phyir/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ yang dag par spong ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i 17—89

phyir / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ yang dag par spong ba rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du yang dag par spong ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ yang dag par spong ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na/ nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rdzu 17—90

'phrul gyi rkang pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ dbang po kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dbang po rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar ①dper na/ nam mkha' la ②ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying ①du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du dbang po stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ dbang po rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ dbang po kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ stobs kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ stobs rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du stobs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ stobs rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te④/ stong pa nyid la ⑤mtha' 17—91

'am ①dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ stobs nyakun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ byang chub kyi yan lag kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya ②zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du byang chub kyi yan lag stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi 0sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am rjodabus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ byang chub kyi yan lag kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na/ nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dasnyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa 17—92

ti'i bu/ de bzhin du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ 'phags pa'i bden pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ 'phags pa'i bden pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ bsam gtan kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ bsam gtan rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir 17—93

zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na/ nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du bsam gtan stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ bsam gtan rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ bsam gtan ①kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ tshad myed pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ tshad myed pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du tshad myed pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ tshad myed pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o / /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu 17—94

mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par thar pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du rnam par thar pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs 17—95

des na/ rnam par thar pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ①kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par /bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi 17—96

ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa ①dang / smon pa myed pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na / mngon par shes pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mngon par shes pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du mngon par shes pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ mngon par shes pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig 17—97

par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ ting nge 'dzin kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ting nge 'dzin rnams ①ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ ting nge 'dzin kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir nam/ gzungs kyi sgo kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du gzungs kyi sgo stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan 17—98

pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ gzungs kyi sgo kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/① de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du ②de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ myi 'jigs pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myi 'jigs pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du myi 'jigs 17—99

pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ myi 'jigs pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na / so so yang dag par rig pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du so so yang dag par rig pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ so so yang dag par rig pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ snying rje chen po kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ snying rje chen po ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/17—100

phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du ①snying rje chen po stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ snying rje chen po'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ snying rje chen po kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dper na nam mkha' la ni sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs te/ mtha' yas kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/nam mkha' zhes mying du brjod do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am dbus myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir na/ gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang 17—101

myed cing myi dmyigs/ tshor ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing myi dmyigs/ 'du shes byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs/ 'du byed byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs/ rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs zhes ①zir ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la gzugs myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba ni tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la tshor ba med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ tshor ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes ni 'du shes kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la 'du shes myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ 'du shes byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba (gyide lta bu yang myed cing myi dmigs so/ /'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la 'du byed myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/'du byed byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rnam par shes pa myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' 17—102

bozhes bya ba de lta bu yang skyed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang myig ni myig gis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la myig myed byang chub sems dpa' skyed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ myig byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba ni rna bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rna ba myed byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rna ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna ni snas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la sna myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ sna byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmigs so/ /lce ni lces stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la lce myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ lce byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus ni lus kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la lus myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ lus byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid ni yid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la yid med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ yid byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la 17—103

gzugs myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sgra ni sgras stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la sgra myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ sgra byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dri ni dris stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la dri myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ dri byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ro ni ros stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la ro myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ ro byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /reg ni reg gis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la reg myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ reg byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos ni chos kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la chos myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ chos byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang myig gi rnam par shes pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la myig gi rnam par shes pa myed/byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam 17—104

grangs des na/ myig gi rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed ci nge myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni sna'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la sna'i rnam par shes pa myed / byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ sna'i rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa ni/ lce'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la lce'i rnam par shes pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / rnam grangs des na/ lce'i rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni/lus kyi rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ yid kyi rnam par shes 17—105

pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / stong pa nyid la lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ lus kyi 17—106

'dus te reg pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi 17—107

dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang sa'i khams ni sa'i khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la sa'i khams myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ sa'i khams byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chu'i khams ni chu'i khams kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la chu'i khams myed/ byang chub sems dpa' 17—108

myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ chu'i khams byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mye'i khams ni/ mye'i khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la mye'i khams myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ mye'i khams byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rlung gi khams ni/ rlung gi khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rlung gi khams myed/byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rlung gi khams byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nam mkha'i khams ni/ nam mkha'i khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la nam mkha'i khams myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ nam mkha'i khams byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni rnam par shes pa'i khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rnam par shes pa'i khams myed / byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ rnam par shes pa'i khams byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/gzhan yang ma rig pa ni ma rig pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la ma rig pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ ma rig pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya 17—109

ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la 'du byed myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ 'du byed byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rnam par shes pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mying dang gzugs ni/ming dang gzugs kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la mying dang gzugs myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / rnam grangs des na/ mying dang gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /skye mched drug ni skye mched drug gis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la skye mched drug myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/skye mched drug byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so / /reg pa ni reg nyupas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la reg pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / rnam grangs des na/ reg pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba ni tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / stong pa nyid la tshor ba myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ tshor ba byang chub sems 17—110

dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sred pa ni sred pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la sred pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/sred pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /len pa ni len pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la len pa med/byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ len pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /srid pa ni srid pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la srid pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ srid pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /skye ba ni skye bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / stong pa nyid la skye ba myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ skye ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rga shi ni rga shis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rga shi myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rga shi byang chub sems dpa' ①zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang ②sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa 17—111

nyid la tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang nang stong pa nyid ni/ nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la nang stong pa nyid med byang chub sems dpa' myed doshe/ /phyi stong pa nyid ni phyi stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la phyi stong pa nyid myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la phyi nang stong pa nyid myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /chen po stong pa nyid ni chen po stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la chen po stong pa nyid myed byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /don 17—112

dam pa stong pa nyid ni don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la don dam pa stong pa nyid myed/ byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / stong pa nyid la 'dus byas stong pa nyid med byang chub sems dpa' myed do//'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid med byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myed/byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni dor ba med rmyepa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la dor ba myed pa ②stong pa nyid myed byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rang bzhin stong pa nyid med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni myi 17—113

dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid med/ byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni/ dngos po skyed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed byang chub sems dpa' med do / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang dran pa nye bar gzhag ①pa rnams ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myed/ byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni/ yang dag par spong ba rnams ②kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la yang dag par spong ba rnams med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /dbang po rnams ni dbang po rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la dbang po rnams myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /stobs rnams ni stobs rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la stobs rnams med byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni byang chub kyi 17—114

yan lag rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed/byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams ni bsam gtan rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la bsam gtan rnams myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni tshad med pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la tshad myed pa rnams med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni rnam par thar pa brgyad kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la rnam par thar pa brgyad med/ byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ①dgus stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa 17—115

dang / smon pa med pas 37stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed sna / byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni mngon par shes pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la mngon par shes pa rnams myed/ byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la ting nge 'dzin rnams med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la gzungs kyi sgo rnams med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams khukyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams ni/myi 'jigs pa rnams kyis 5stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la myi 'jigs pa rnams med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed/byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /snying rje chen po ni/ snying rje chen pos stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la snying rje chen po myed mibyang chub sems dpa' med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ༅med/ byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /chos kyi 17—116

dbyings ni chos kyi dbyings kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la chos kyi dbyings med/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /de bzhin nyid ni de bzhin nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la de bzhin nyid med / byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' ni yang dag pa'i mthas ②stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la yang dag pa'i mtha' myed/ byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings ni/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / stong pa nyid la bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la thams cad shes pa nyid med/byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid tri ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la lam gyi rnam pa dushes pa nyid med/ byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / stong pa nyid la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa ni nyan thos kyi theg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la nyan thos kyi theg pa med byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa myed/ byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni sangs rgyas kyi theg pas stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la sangs rgyas kyi theg pa myed byang chub sems 17—117

dpa' myed do/ /nyan thos ni nyan thos kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/stong pa nyid la nyan thos myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas ni rang sangs rgyas kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la rang sangs rgyas myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni ①de bzhin gshegs pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa myed byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/gang yang 'di skad du bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' thams cad du thams cad rnam pa thams cad du thams cad mi dmyigs na byang chub sems dpa' ni gang zhig /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gang zhig la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bya zhes zer ba ci'i phyir de skad du smras zhes zhuzer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs ni gzugs la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs ni tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba ni tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba ni gzugs la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs dang tshor ba ni 'du shes la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes ni 'du shes la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes ni gzugs dang tshor ba la myed cing myi 17——118

dmyigs so/ /gzugs dang tshor ba dang 'du shes ni 'du byed rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed rnams ni 'du byed rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed rnams ni ①gzugs dang tshor ba dang 'du shes la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs dang tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed rnams ni rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa ni gzugs dang tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed rnams ②la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu mig ni myig la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig ni rna ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba ni rna ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba ni myig la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig dang rna ba ni sna la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna ni sna la med cing myi chadamyigs so/ /sna ni myig dang rna ba la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig dang rna ba dang sna ni lce la myed cing myi dmyigs so / /lce ni lce la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce ni myig dang rna ba dang sna la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce ni lus la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus ni lus la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus ni myig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus ni yid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid ni yid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid ni myig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs ni gzugs la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs ni sgra la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sgra ni sgra la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sgra ni gzugs la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs dang sgra ni dri la myed cing myi 17—119

dmyigs so/ /dri ni dri la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dri ni gzugs dang sgra la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri ni ro la myed cing myi dmyigs so / /ro ni ro la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /ro ni gzugs dang sgra dang dri la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro ni reg la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /reg ni reg la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /reg ni gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg ni chos la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos ni chos la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chos ni gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa dang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni sna'i rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni sna'i rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa ni lce'i rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so//lce'i rnam par shes pa ni lce'i rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa ni/ myig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 17—120

rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa ni lus kyi rnam par shes pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni lus kyi rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pa dang /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pa dang /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni myig bi 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni ①17—121

lce'i 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang /sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang /sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs sol/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni myig gi 17—122

'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ①ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ②ba dang /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ②ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ④ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ⑤ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ⑥ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ⑦ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor khyab dang /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor spub dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las 17—123

byung ba'i tshor 37ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ②ba dang /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor chab dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ④ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor thub dang /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor byub dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ⑦ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor dub dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor spub dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor 6ba dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor nyuskreb dang / lus kyi 'dus te 8reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya lhonyepa/ bam po bzhi hustepa/sa'i khams ni sa'i khams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /sa'i khams ni chu'i khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chu'i khams ni chu'i khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /chu'i khams ni sa'i khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sa'i ci khams dang chu'i khams ni me'i khams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /mye'i khams ni / me'i khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /me'i khams ni sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sa'i khams dang / chu'i 17—124

khams dang / mye'i khams ni/ rlung gi khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rlung gi khams ni rlung gi khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rlung gi khams ni sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so//sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams khyani nam mkha'i khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nam mkha'i khams ni nam mkha'i khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nam mkha'i khams ni sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sa'i khams dang chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang /rlung gi khams dang / nam mkha'i khams ni rnam par shes pa'i khams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni rnam par shes pa'i khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni/ sa'i khams dang /chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang / nam mkha'i khams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa ni ma rig pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa ni/ 'du byed la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed ni/ 'du byed la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed ni/ ma rig pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa dang / 'du byed ni/ rnam par shes pa la myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa ni/ rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa ni ma rig pa dang / 'du byed la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa ni mying dang gzugs la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mying dang gzugs ni mying dang gzugs la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mying dang gzugs ni ma rig pa dang 'du 17—125

byed dang rnam par shes pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / pying dang gzugs ni skye mched drug la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /skye mched drug ni skye mched drug la myed cing myi dmyigs so//skye mched drug ni ma rig pa dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa dang 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug ni reg pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /reg pa ni reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /reg pa ni ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang reg pa ni tshor ba la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba ni tshor ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba ni ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang tshor ba ni sred pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sred pa ni sred pa la med cing mi dmyigs so/ /sred pa ni ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang /tshor ba la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang tshor ba dang sred pa ni lend pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lend pa 17—126

ni lend pa la med cing mi dmyigs so/ /lend pa ni ma rig pa dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang reg pa dang / tshor ba dang sred pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang reg pa dang tshor ba dang sred pa dang / len pa ni srid pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /srid pa ni srid pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /srid pa ni ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang tshor ba dang / srid ①pa dang len pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang tshor ba dang sred ②pa dang len pa dang / srid pa ni skye ba la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /skye ba ni skye ba la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /skye ba ni ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang tshor ba dang sred pa dang len pa dang / srid pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang tshor ba dang sred pa dang len pa dang / srid pa dang skye ba ni rga shi la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rga shi ni rga shi la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rga shi ni ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang /skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang tshor ba dang sred ②pa dang / len pa dang srid pa dang / skye ba la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 17—127

ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi 17—128

pha rol tu phyin pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid ni phyi stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid ni phyi stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid ni /snaphyi nang stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni phyi nang stong pa nyid la med cing mi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid dang phyi stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni chen po stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /chen po 17—129

stong pa nyid ni chen po stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid ni don dam pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa 17nyid ni don dam pa stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /chen po stong pa nyid la med cing mi dmigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'dus rgyabyas stong pa nyid ni/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa dul myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid 17—130
