dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la myed cing mi dmyigs so / /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid chodang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi 17—131

dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid ni dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid ni/ nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid 517la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 17—132

dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la med cing mi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so//chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa sto nga pa nyid dang ①/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la myed cing myi 17—133

dmyigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang ①/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin 17—134

stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so//dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma 17—135

dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang /kū'adus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni②/dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dngos 17—136

po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni/nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so//dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni/ yang dag par spong ba rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni yang dag par spong ba rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so / /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang /yang dag par spong ba rnams la myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni dbang po rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po rnams ni dbang po rnams la 17—137

myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang /yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po rnams ni stobs rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /stobs rnams ni stobs rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /stobs rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa dang / dbang po rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs rnams ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni lam la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lam ni lam la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lam ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni bsam gtan rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan rnams 17—138

ni bsam gtan rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan rnams ni tshad myed pa rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so//tshad med pa rnams ni tshad med pa rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa rnams ni gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la med cing myi dmigs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa dang /bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni rnam par thar pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa rnams ni/ rnam par thar pa rnams la myed cing myi dmigs so/ /rnam par thar pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dang /bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa rnams ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 17—139

rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par ('jug pa rnams ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams la skyed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa dang /bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dang /bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni mngon par shes pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad 17—140

myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / mngon par shes pa rnams ni/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ting nge 'dzin rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa dang /bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / mngon par shes pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dang bsam gtan dang /tshad myed pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms ①par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / mngon par shes pa tshorgyadang / ting nge 'dzin rnams ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / bsam gtan dang tshad myed pa dang /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang /mngon par shes pa dang ting nge 'dzin rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni mi 'jigs pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams ni myi 'jigs pa 17—141

rnams la myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang myi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni/ byams pa chen po la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byams pa chen po ni byams pa chen po la myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /byams pa chen po ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / myi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so//de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / myi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / byams pa chen po ni snying rje chen po la myed cing myi dmyigs so / /snying rje chen po ni snying rje chen po la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / myi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / byams pa chen po la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / myi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po ni ①sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni/ de bzhin gshegs 17—142

pa'i stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang /byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po ①rnams dul myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rigs kyi sa'i chos rnams ni/ rigs kyi sa'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rigs kyi sa'i chos ②ni brgyad pa'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /brgyad pa'i chos rnams ni brgyad pa'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmigs so/ /brgyad pa'i chos rnams ni/ rigs kyi sa'i chos byal myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rigs kyi sa'i chos dang brgyad pa'i chos rnams ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos rnams ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos rnams ni/ rigs kyi sa'i chos dang / brgyad pa'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rigs kyi sa'i chos dang brgyad pa'i chos dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos rnams ni/ lan cig ⑤phyir 'ong ba'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos rnams ni/lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos rnams ni/ rigs kyi sa'i chos dang / brgyad pa'i chos dang /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rigs kyi sa'i chos dang / brgyad pa'i chos dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos rnams ni/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i chos rnams ni/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i chos rnams ni/ rigs kyi sa'i chos dang / brgyad pa'i chos dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos dang / lan 17—143

cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /rigs kyi sa'i chos dang / brgyad pa'i chos dang rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i chos rnams ni/ dgra bcom pa'i chos rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /dgra bcom pa'i chos rnams ni/ dgra bcom pa'i chos rnams la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /dgra bcom pa'i chos rnams ni rigs kyi sa'i chos dang / brgyad pa'i chos dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos hu)dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i chos rnams la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ / so so'i skye bo'i sa ni ②so so'i ②skye bo'i sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /so so'i ༅skye bo'i sa ni rigs kyi sa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /so so'i 5skye bo'i sa dang rigs kyi sa ni brgyad pa'i sa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /brgyad pa'i sa ni brgyad pa'i sa la med cing myi dmyigs so//brgyad pa'i sa ni so so'i skye bo'i sa dang / rigs kyi sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so / /so so'i skye bo'i sa dang / rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i sa ni mthong ba'i sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mthong ba'i sa ni mthong ba'i sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /mthong ba'i sa ni so so'i skye bo'i sa dang / rigs kyi sa dang brgyad pa'i sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /so so'i skye bo'i sa dang rigs kyi sa dang brgyad pa'i sa dang mthong ba'i sa ni bslabs ⑥pa'i sa la med cing mi myigs so/ /bslabs pa'i sa ni bsrabs pa'i sa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /bsrabs pa'i sa ni so so'i skye bo'i sa dang / rigs kyi sa dang brgyad pa'i sa dang / mthong ba'i sa la myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /so so'i skye bo'i sa dang rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i sa dang mthong ba'i sa dang / bslabs pa'i sa 17—144

ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa ni/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa la med cing myi dmyigs so//'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa ni so so'i skye bo'i sa dang rigs kyi sa dang /brgyad pa'i sa dang mthong ba'i sa dang bslabs pa'i sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so//so so'i skye bo'i sa dang / rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i sa dang mthong ba'i sa dang / bslabs pa'i sa dang 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa ni/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byas pa rtogs pa'i sa ni byas pa rtogs pa'i sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byas pa rtogs pa'i sa ni so so'i skye bo'i sa dang / rigs kyi sa dang brgyad pa'i sa dang mthong ba'i sa dang bsrabs pa'i sa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /so so'i skye bo'i sa dang rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i sa dang mthong ba'i sa dang / bslabs pa'i sa dang 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang / byas pa rtogs pa'i sa ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi sa ni rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi kū sa ni so so'i skye bo'i sa dang / rigs kyi sa dang brgyad pa'i sa dang / mthong ba'i sa dang bsrabs pa'i sa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang / byas pa rtogs pa'i sa la myed cing mi dmigs so/ /so so'i skye bo'i sa dang rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i sa dang mthong ba'i sa dang /bsrabs pa'i sa dang 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang / byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa la myed cing myi dmigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa la myed 17—145

cing mi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa ni so so'i skye bo'i sa dang /rigs kyi sa dang brgyad pa'i sa dang / mthong ba'i sa dang bslabs pa'i sa dang /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang / byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /so so'i skye bo'i sa dang rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i sa dang mthong ba'i sa dang / bsrabs pa'i sa dang /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang / byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa ni/ so so'i skye bo'i sa dang /rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i sa dang / mthong ba'i sa dang bslabs pa'i sa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang / byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa la myed cing myi dmyigs so / /thams cad shes pa nyid ni thams cad shes pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad shes pa nyid ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni thams cad shes pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad shes pa nyid dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la med cing mi dmyigs so//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni thams cad shes pa nyid 17—146

dang / lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa ni rgyun tu zhugs pa la myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba ni rgyun tu zhugs pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba ni ②phyir mi 'ong ba la med cing mi dmigs so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba ni phyir myi 'ong ba la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /phyir mi 'ong ba ni rgyun tu zhugs pa dang lan cig phyir 'ong ba la med cing mi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba ni dgra bcom pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /dgra bcom pa ni dgra bcom pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /dgra bcom pa ni rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dul med cing myi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa dang lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa ni rang sangs rgyas la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas ni rang sangs rgyas la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas ni rgyun tu zhugs pa dang /lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa la myed cing mi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang /phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas ni byang chub sems dpa' la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni byang chub sems dpa' la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra 17—147

bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas la med cing myi dmigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' ni de bzhin gshegs pa la med cing mi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni byang chub sems dpa' la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni byang chub sems dpa' la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gdams shing rjes su bstan pa la myed cing myi dmyigs so/ /gdams shing rjes su bstan pa ni/ gdams shing rjes su bstan pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /gdams shing rjes su bstan pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar ①chos thams cad myed cing dmyigs su myed pas / byang chub sems dpa' myed cing dmyigs su med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gang yang 'di skad du ci'i phyir ②na/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam yin zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni glo 17—148

bur du mying du btags ①pa ste/ de'i ②phyir na 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ②ni mying tsam mo ④zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes ⑤bya ba dang / tshor ba zhes bya ba dang /'du shes zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed ces bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ glo ༅bur du mying du btags pa ste/ 'di ltar mying ni gang nas kyang mi 'ong gang du yang mi 'gro gang na yang myi gnas so/ /mying tsam zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin/ de ni tshor ba ma yin/ de ni 'du shes ma yin/ de ni 'du byed ma yin/ de ni rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying ni ming gi rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /stong pa gang yin pa cide ni mying ma yin te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ myig ces bya ba dang / rna ba zhes ④bya ba dang / sna zhes bya ba dang / lce zhes bya ba dang / lus zhes bya ba dang / yid ces bya khyab 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags ⑨pa ste/ 'di ltar mying ni gang nas kyang mi 'ong gang du yang mi 'gro gang na yang myi gnas so/ /mying tsam zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni/mig ma yin/ de ni rna ba ma yin/ de ni sna ma yin/ de ni lce ma yin/ de ni lus ma yin0 / de ni yid ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar ming ni mying gi rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /stong pa gang yin pa de ni mying ma yin te / de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bya ba dang / sgra zhes bya ba dang / dri zhes bya ba dang / ro zhes bya ba 17—149

dang / reg ces bya ba dang / chos zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du ming du btags pa ste/ 'di ltar mying ni gang nas kyang mi 'ong gang du yang myi 'gro gang na yang 〉myi gnas so/ /mying tsam zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni gzugs ma yin / de ni sgra ma yin/ de ni dri ma yin/ de ②ni ro ma yin/ de ni reg ma yin/ de ni chos ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar ming ni ming gi rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /stong pa gang yin pa de ni mying ma yin tezhu/de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam zhes bya'o / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ mig gi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni glo rngubur du ming du btags pa ste/ 'di ltar mying ni gang nas kyang mi 'ong gang du yang mi 'gro gang na yang mi gnas so/ /mying tsam zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni/mig gi rnam par shes pa ma yin/ de ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ma yin/ de ni sna'i rnam par shes pa ma yin/ de ni lce'i rnam par shes pa ma yin/ de ni lus kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin/ de ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar ming ni ming gi rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /stong pa gang yin pa de ni mying ma yin te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/'di lta ste/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba dang / lce'i 'dus te 17—150

reg pa zhes bya ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ 'di ltar ming ni gang nas kyang myi 'ong gang du yang myi 'gro gang na yang myi gnas so/ /mying tsam zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa ma yin/ de ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin/ de ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin/ de ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin/ de ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin/ de ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying ni mying gi rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /stong pa gang yin pa de ni mying ma yin te/de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam zhes bya'o / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ 'di ltar mying ni gang nas kyang mi 'ong gang du yang myi 'gro gang na yang myi gnas so/ /mying tsam zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin/ de ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin/de ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin/ de ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin/ de ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin/ de ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /17—151

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying ni mying gi rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /stong pa gang yin pa de ni mying ma yin te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/'di lta ste/ sa'i khams zhes bya ba dang / chu'i khams zhes bya ba dang /mye'i khams zhes bya ba dang / rlung gi khams zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha'i khams shes —1bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags 37pa ste/ 'di ltar mying ni gang nas kyang myi 'ong gang du yang myi 'gro zhugang na yang myi gnas so/ /mying tsam zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni sa'i khams ma yin/ de ni chu'i khams ma yin/ de ni mye'i khams ma yin/de ni rlung gi khams ma yin/ de ni nam mkha'i khams ma yin/ de ni rnam par shes pa'i khams ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying ni mying gi rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /stong pa gang yin pa de ni mying ma yin te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mying tsam zhes bya'o / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa zhes bya ba dang /'du byed ces ③bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba dang / mying dang gzugs zhes bya ba dang / skye mched drug ces bya ba dang / reg pa zhes bya ba dang / tshor ba zhes bya ba dang / sred pa zhes bya ba dang / len pa zhes bya ba dang / srid pa zhes bya ba dang / skye ba zhes bya ba dang / rga shi zhes bya ba 'di ni'u/ glo bur du mying du btags snopa ste/ 'di ltar mying ni gang nas kyang myi 'ong gang du yang myi 'gro gang na yang myi gnas so/ /mying tsam zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ༅ni ma rig pa ma yin/ de ni 'du byed ma yin/ de ni rnam 17—152

par shes pa ma yin/ de ni mying dang gzugs ma yin/ de ni skye mched drug ma yin/ de ni reg pa ma yin/ de ni tshor ba ma yin/ de ni sred pa ma yin/de ni len pa ma yin/ de ni srid pa ma yin/ de ni skye ba ma yin/ de ni rga shi ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying ni mying gi rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /stong pa gang yin pa de ni mying ma yin te①/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lta ste ②phying gang yin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa zhude gnyis ka yang myed cing mi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam mo/ /'di lta ste tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa med/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ming tsam ste/ mying la yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar ming gang yin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 17—153

'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang ming med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa med/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar ming gang yin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste / byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/nang stong pa nyid 'di 17ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang nang stong pa nyid myed/nang stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ phyi stong pa nyid 'di ②ni mying tsam ste/ mying la 17—154

yang phyi stong pa nyid myed/ phyi stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ phyi nang stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang phyi nang stong pa nyid myed/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te①/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/mying la yang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka ya nga myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/② byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo /'di lta ste/ chen po stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang chen po stong pa nyid myed/ chen po stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ don dam pa stong pa nyid 'di ni ming tsam ste/ ming ④la yang don dam pa stong pa nyid myed/don dam pa stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang 17—155

myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid 'di ①ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang 'dus byas stong pa nyid myed/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/mying la yang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid myed/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing mi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub 17—156

sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang dor ba med pa stong pa nyid myed/dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/mying la yang chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang /chos thams cad stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing mi dmyigs te / de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/17—157

mying la yang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang dngos po med pa stong pa nyid myed/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /'di lta ste/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni mying tsam ste/ mying la yang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la yang mying med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam zhes bya'o/ /17—158

tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags ①pa ste/ mying la yang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myed/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la yang mying med do//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ yang dag par spong ba rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang yang ②dag par spong ba rnams myed/ yang dag par spong ba rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bul/ 'di lta ste/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du ming du btags pa ste/ mying la yang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/dbang po rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags ②pa ste/ mying la yang dbang po rnams myed/ dbang po rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / dbang po rnams gang yin pa 17—159

de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i hu)phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/'di lta ste/ stobs rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/mying la yang stobs rnams myed/ stobs rnams la yang ②phying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / stobs rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams zhugang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la yang ming myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing mi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/'di lta ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed/ 'phags 17—160

pa'i bden pa rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/bsam gtan rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang bsam gtan rnams myed/ bsam gtan rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / bsam gtan rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ tshad med pa rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang tshad myed pa rnams myed/ tshad med pa rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang /tshad myed pa rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang )myed cing myi dmyigs te/de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la yang mying med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar ming gang yin pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa 17—161

ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ rnam par thar pa rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang rnam par thar pa rnams med/ rnam par thar pa rnams la yang ming myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / rnam par thar pa rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du ming du btags pa ste/ mying la yang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu med/mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la yang mying med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du ming du btags pa ste/ mying la yang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ①rnams myed/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ②rnams la yang nimying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams ④gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa ②sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ mngon par shes pa rnams zhes 17—162

bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang mngon par shes pa rnams myed/ mngon par shes pa rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / 'di ltar ming gang yin pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing ①kyi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bul/ 'di lta ste/ ting nge 'dzin rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du ming du btags pa ste/ mying la yang ting nge 'dzin rnams myed/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te / de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myed/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang 17—163

chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / 'di lta ste/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang myi 'jigs pa rnams myed/ myi 'jigs pa rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te / de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ byams pa chen po zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang byams pa chen po myed/byams pa chen po la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / byams pa chen po gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang med cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ snying rje chen po zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang snying rje chen po myed / snying rje chen po la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / snying rje chen po gang ①yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing 17—164

myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o ①brgyad ces bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste / mying la yang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myed/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/'di lta ste/ thams cad shes pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang thams cad shes pa nyid myed/ thams cad shes pa nyid la yang mying myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / thams cad shes pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ lam gyi rnam pa ②shes pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags pa ste/ mying la yang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la yang mying myed dospyo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di lta ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni glo bur du mying du btags ②pa ste/ mying la yang rnam pa thams 17—165

cad mkhyen pa nyid myed/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la yang pying myed do//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mying gang yin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang yin pa de gnyis ka yang myed cing myi dmyigs te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam mo// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po lnga ①pa/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gang yang 'di skad du dper na/ bdag bdag ces bya ste/ ②bdag shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na sems can sems can zhes bya ste/ sems can shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na srog srog ces bya ste/ srog shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na 'gro ba 'gro ba zhes bya ste/ 'gro ba shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na gso ba gso dub zhes bya ste/ gso ④ba shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na skyes bu skyes bu zhes bya ste/ skyes bu shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na gang zag gang zag ces bya ste/ gang zag shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na shed can shed can zhes bya ste/ shed can shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na shed bdag shed bdag ces bya ste/ shed bdag shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na byed pa po byed pa po zhes bya ste/ byed pa po shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na tshor ba po tshor ba po zhes bya ste/ tshor ba po shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na shes pa po shes pa po zhes bya ste/ shes pa po shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /dper na mthong ba po mthong ba po zhes bya ste/mthong ba po shin tu mngon par ma grub bo/ /zhes ci'i phyir de skad du smras duzhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ bdag shin tu myed cing myi 17—166

dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sems can shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod / srog shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'gro ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ gso ①ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na / de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ skyes bu shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ gang zag shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ shed can shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ shed bdag shin tu med cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ byed pa po shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshor ba po shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod / shes pa po shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ mthong ba po shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ gzugs shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshor ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/'du shes shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'du byed shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rnam par shes pa shin tu myed cing myi 17—167

dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myig shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/rna ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sna shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lce shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lus shin tu med cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ yid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ gzugs shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod / sgra shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dri shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ ro shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ reg ①shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ chos shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myig gi rnam par shes pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sna'i rnam par shes pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/lce'i rnam par shes pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa shin tu myed cing myi 17—168

dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/sna'i 'dus te reg pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na / de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na①/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sa'i khams shin tu myed cing 17—169

myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ chu'i khams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ mye'i khams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rlung gi khams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na / de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ nam mkha'i khams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod / rnam par shes pa'i khams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ ma rig pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na / de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'du byed shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/rnam par shes pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ mying dang gzugs shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par ①'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ skye mched drug shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ reg pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba dulta ga la yod/ tshor ba shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sred pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ len pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ srid pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ skye ba shin tu med cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/17—170

rga shi shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod / nang stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la ①yod/ phyi stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ phyi nang stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ chen po stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ don dam pa stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la 17—171

yod / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/chos thams cad stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dran pa nye bar gzhag 37pa rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ yang dag par spong ba rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon tshar 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dbang po rnams shin tu med cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ stobs 17—172

rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bsam gtan rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshad myed pa rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rnam par thar pa brgyad shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pa shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/mngon par shes pa rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ ting nge 'dzin rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/gzungs kyi sgo rnams shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu shin tu 17—173

myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/myi 'jigs pa bzhi shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/byams pa chen po shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ snying rje chen po shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de ①mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ nyan thos shin tu med cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rang sangs rgyas shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ byang chub sems dpa' shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de ②mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shin tu myed cing myi dmyigs na/ de ②mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ bdag bdag ces kyang bya ste/ bdag shin tu mngon par grub ④pa med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang gang chos thams cad kyang de bzhin du dngos ①po med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin nam zhes zer ba de ⑥ni/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de de ⑦bzhin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do / /sha ra dwa ti'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gang la 'du ba 17—174

las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed pa yin/ smras pa gzugs la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /tshor ba la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /'du shes la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /'du byed la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rnam par shes pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myig la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rna ba la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /sna la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /lce la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /lus la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /yid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /①gzugs la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /sgra la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /dri la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /ro la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do//reg la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /chos la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /②phyig gi rnam par shes pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do / /sna'i rnam par shes pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /②phyig gi 'dus te reg pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo 17—175

nyid myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do / /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /①myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la ②'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /zhusa'i khams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /chu'i khams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do④/ /me'i khams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rlung gi khams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /phyam rig pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /'du byed la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rnam par shes pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /mying dang gzugs la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /skye mched drug la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /reg pa la ⑥'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /tshor ba la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /sred pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /len pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /srid pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /skye 17—176

ba la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rga shi la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /①sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la ②'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed dol/ /chanang stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ④ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /myi dmigs pa stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la 'du 17—177

ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid ①do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /②dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /dbang po rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /stobs rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /②'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ngul 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /so 17—178

so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /byams pa chen po la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /snying rje chen po la ①'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la 'du ba las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / rnam grangs des na/ chos thams cad ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid ②do / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang chos thams cad ni dumi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor chos thams cad byartsi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin pa de dag gang yin/ /smras pa tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /tshor ba myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /'du shes myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /'du byed myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no//rnam par shes pa myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ / rgyasnyig myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /rna ba myi rtag pa ste/gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /sna myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /lce myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /lus myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /yid myi rtag pa ste/gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /zhugazugs myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /sgra myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /dri myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /ro myi rtag pa ste/gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /reg myi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral 17—179
