tshor ba mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog gol/ /tshor ba smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshor ba zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshor ba dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /sred pa rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go / /sred pa bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sred pa bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sred pa sdug ces bya ba dang myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//sred pa stong zhes bya ba dang myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sred pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go//sred pa smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go / /sred pa zhi zhes bya ba dang ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sred pa dben zhes bya ba dang myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /len pa rtag ces bya ba dang myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /len pa bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /len pa bdag ces bya ba dang bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /len pa sdug ces bya ba dang myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /len pa stong zhes bya ba dang myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /len pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /len pa smon pa yod ces bya ba dang smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /len pa zhi zhes bya ba dang ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /len pa dben zhes bya ba dang myi dben 17—420

zhes bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /srid pa rtag ces bya ba dang myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /srid pa bde zhes bya ba dang sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /srid pa bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /srid pa sdug ces bya ba dang myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /srid pa stong zhes bya ba dang myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /srid pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /srid pa smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /srid pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /srid pa dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /skye ba rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /skye ba bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /skye ba bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /skye ba sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya ①bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /skye ba stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /skye ba mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /skye ba smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /skye ba zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /skye ba dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rga shi rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rga shi bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rga shi bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar 17—421

yongs su myi rtog go/ /rga shi sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rga shi stong zhes bya ba dang / mi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rga shi mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rga shi smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rga shi zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rga shi dben zhes bya ba dang / mi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gnyis ①pa/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtag ces bya ba dang /myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bde 17—422

zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog gol/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bde zhes bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dben zhes 17—423

bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba dang /myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//17—424

bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi ①rtog go/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dben zhes bya ba dang /myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /nang stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /nang stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /nang stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /nang stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /nang stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//17—425

nang stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /nang stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /nang stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang /ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /nang stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang /myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang /mi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang /myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//phyi nang stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go / /phyi nang stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed 17—426

ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba ①dang /bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chen po stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog gol/ /chen po stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chen po stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chen po stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang /myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chen po stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chen po stong pa nyid mtshan 17—427

ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chen po stong pa ①nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chen po stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chen po stong pa ②nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong 17—428

zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /17—429

mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang /myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang /sdug ①bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba ②dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang /myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog gol/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar 17—430

yongs su myi rtog go/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang /myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su 17—431

myi rtog go/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ②stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma skyed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba ②dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang /bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang /mtshan ma skyed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//17—432

rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang /myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed 17—433

ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / mi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po skyed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po 17—434

myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang /myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang /ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar 17—435

yongs su myi rtog go/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams bdag ces bya ba dang /bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / mi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dbang po rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag 17—436

ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dbang po rnams bde zhes bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dbang po rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dbang po rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dbang po rnams stong zhes ①bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ / dbang po rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dbang po rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /②dbang po rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dbang po rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi ①rtog go/ /dbang po rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang /ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /dbang po rnams dben zhes bya ba dang /myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stobs rnams rtag ces bya ba dang /myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stobs rnams bde zhes bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stobs rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stobs rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stobs rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stobs rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//stobs rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stobs rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /stobs rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs 17—437

su myi rtog go/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams zhi zhes bya ba ①dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong zhes bya ba dang /myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa smon pa yo da ces bya ba ②dang / smon pa 17—438

myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi ①rtog go/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan rnams rtag ②ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan rnams stong zhes bya ba dang /myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan rnams mtshan ma yod 17—439

ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /bsam gtan rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshad myed pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang /myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshad myed pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshad myed pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshad myed pa rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshad myed pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go / /tshad myed pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshad myed pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshad myed pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /tshad myed pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzugs myed 17—440

pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ①ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag skyed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa rnams sdug ces bya ba ②dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug 17—441

bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar 17—442

yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa smon pa ①yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa ②skyed pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa ②skyed pa dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mngon par shes pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mngon par shes pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mngon par shes pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mngon par shes pa rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mngon par shes pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang /myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mngon par shes pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mngon par shes pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /mngon par shes pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /mngon par shes pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ting nge 17—443

'dzin rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//ting nge 'dzin rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go / /ting nge 'dzin rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag skyed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams dben zhes bya ba dang myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag 17—444

ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sdug ces bya ba dang /myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su mi rtog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /17—445

myi 'jigs pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byams pa chen po rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byams pa chen po bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byams pa chen po bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byams pa chen po sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byams pa chen po stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byams pa chen po mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byams pa chen po smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya 17—446

bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byams pa chen po zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /byams pa chen po dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /snying rje chen po rtag ces bya ba dang /myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /snying rje chen po bde zhes bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /snying rje chen po bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /snying rje chen po sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /snying rje chen po stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /snying rje chen po mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go / /snying rje chen po smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /snying rje chen po zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /snying rje chen po dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go / /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos 17—447

ma 'dres pa rnams smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams zhi zhes bya ba dang /ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thams cad shes pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//thams cad shes pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thams cad shes pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thams cad shes pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang /myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thams cad shes pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thams cad shes pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go①//thams cad shes pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thams cad shes pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /thams cad shes pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang /myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go//lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid sdug ces bya ba rgyadang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa 17—448

nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / myi rtag ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sdug ces bya ba dang / myi sdug ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / myi stong zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dben zhes bya ba dang / myi dben zhes bya bar yongs su myi rtog go/ /de ①lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos 'di dag la②/ yongs su rtog pa skyed pa'i tshul gyis②/ de ④ltar yongs su rtog go// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phyag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gsum 0pa/17—449

smras pa tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir/ de skad du/ gzugs kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin/ tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni / tshor ba ma yin/ 'du shes kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'du shes ma yin/ 'du byed kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'du byed ma yin/rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa ma yin zhes zer / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/ myig gi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ myig ma yin/ rna ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/rna ba ma yin/ sna'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ sna ma yin/ lce'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ lce ma yin/ lus kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/lus ma yin/ yid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ yid ma yin zhes zer/tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/ gzugs kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs ma yin/ sgra'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/sgra ma yin/ dri'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ dri ma yin/ ro'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ ro ma yin/ reg gi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ reg ma yin/ chos kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ chos ma yin zhes zer/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/ myig gi rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi rnam par shes pa ma yin/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ma yin / sna'i rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i rnam par shes pa ma yin/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i rnam par shes pa ma yin/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/17—450

lus kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin zhes zer/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa ma yin/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin/lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin zhes zer/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin/rna ba'i 'dus te ①reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin zhes zer/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/17—451

sa'i khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ sa'i khams ma yin/ chu'i khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ chu'i khams ma yin/ mye'i khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ me'i khams ma yin/ rlung gi khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rlung gi khams ma yin/ nam mkha'i khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ nam mkha'i khams ma yin/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa'i khams ma yin zhes zer/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/ ma rig pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ ma rig pa ma yin/ 'du byed kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni / 'du byed ma yin/ rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/rnam par shes pa ma yin/ mying dang gzugs kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/mying dang gzugs ma yin/ skye mched drug gi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/skye mched drug ma yin/ reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ reg pa ma yin / tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ tshor ba ma yin/ sred pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ sred pa ma yin/ len pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ len pa ma yin/ srid pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ srid pa ma yin/ skye ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ skye ba ma yin/ rga shi'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rga shi ma yin zhes zer/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ①ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/17—452

bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa 1phogang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin zhes zer/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/ nang stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ nang stong pa nyid ma yin/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ phyi stong pa nyid ma yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi snum skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ma yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ma yin/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ chen po stong pa nyid ma yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ma yin / 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ma yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ chos thams cad stong 17—453

pa nyid ma yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ma yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin/ dngos po )myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin zhes zer/tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma yin / yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ yang dag par spong ba rnams ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ma yin/ dbang po rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ dbang po rnams ma yin/ stobs rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ stobs rnams ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ma yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ma yin/ bsam gtan rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan rnams ma yin/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ tshad myed pa rnams ma yin/ gzugs myed 2pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs 17—454

myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa rnams ma yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/mthar kyis ①gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par 37thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ma yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ ting nge 'dzin rnams ma yin/gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams ma yin / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ma yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ myi 'jigs pa rnams ma yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa zhurnams ma yin/ byams pa chen po'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ byams pa chen po ma yin/ snying rje chen po'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ snying rje chen po ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ma yin zhes zer/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid ma yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ma yin/17—455

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin/ zhes zer/ rab 'byor kyis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni gzugs ma yin te/ skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ gzugs kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de gzugs ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ tshor ba ni tshor bas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni tshor ba ma yin te/ skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de chotshor ba ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'du shes ni 'du shes kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni 'du shes ma yin te/ skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ 'du shes kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de 'du shes ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni 'du byed ma yin te/ skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa du ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ 'du byed kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de zhu'adu byed ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma yin te/ skye ba myed do / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de krurnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myig ni myig krugis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni myig ma yin te/skye ba myed do/ / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ myig gi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de myig ma yin no/ /༅tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/17—456

rna ba ni rna bas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rna ba ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rna ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ②rna ba ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sna ni snas stong ste/gang stong pa de ni sna ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ sna'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de sna ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ lce ni lces stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni lce ma yin te/skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ lce'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de lce ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ lus ni lus kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni lus ma yin te/ skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ lus kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de lus ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ yid ni yid kyis stong ste/gang stong pa de ni yid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ yid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de rgyayid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni gzugs ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ gzugs kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de gzugs ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sgra ni sgras stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni sgra ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/sgra'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de sgra ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/dri ni dris stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni dri ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ dri'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de dudri 17—457

ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ro ni ros stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni ro ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ ro'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ro ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ reg ni reg gis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni reg ma yin te skye ba myed do/ —/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ reg gi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de reg ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ chos ni chos kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni chos ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ chos kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de chos ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myig gi rnam par shes pa ni mig gi rnam par shes pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni myig gi rnam par shes pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/myig gi rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de myig gi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sna'i rnam par shes pa ni sna'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni sna'i rnam par shes pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de sna'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ lce'i rnam par shes pa ni lce'i rnam par shes pas stong 17—458

ste / gang stong pa de ni lce'i rnam par shes pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de lce'i rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni lus kyi rnam par shes pas stong ste/gang stong pa de ni lus kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de lus kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pas stong ste/gang stong pa de ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de yid kyi rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/gang stong pa de ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de myig gi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/gang stong pa de ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de hu)rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha 17—459

ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ①sna'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni lce'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de (lce'i 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis 17—460

tshor ba ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin te skye ba med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis lhatshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de lus kyi du'adus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa 17—461

sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ma yin no / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sa'i khams ni sa'i khams kyis stong ste/gang stong pa de ni sa'i khams ma yin te/ skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ sa'i khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de sa'i khams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ chu'i khams ni chu'i khams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni chu'i khams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ chu'i khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de chu'i khams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mye'i khams ni mye'i khams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni mye'i khams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ mye'i khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de mye'i khams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rlung gi khams ni rlung gi khams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rlung gi khams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rlung gi khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de rlung gi khams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nam mkha'i khams ni nam mkha'i khams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni nam mkha'i khams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ nam mkha'i khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de nam mkha'i khams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par shes pa'i khams ni rnam par shes pa'i khams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rnam par shes pa'i khams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /17—462

tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ①rnam par shes pa'i khams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ma rig pa ni ma rig pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni ma rig pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ ma rig pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ma rig pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni 'du byed ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ 'du byed kyi ma skyes pa gang yin ṅge de 'du byed ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ste/gang stong pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra khudwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mying dang gzugs ni mying dang gzugs kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni mying dang gzugs ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ ming dang gzugs kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de mying dang gzugs ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ skye mched drug ni skye mched drug gis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni skye mched drug ma yin te skye ba myed do / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ skye mched drug gi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de skye mched drug ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ reg pa ni reg pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni reg pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ reg 17—463

pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de reg pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / tshor ba ni tshor bas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni tshor ba ma yin te/skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ tshor ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de 1tshor ba ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sred pa ni srid pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni sred pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ sred pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de sred pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / len pa ni len pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni len pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ len pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de len pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/srid pa ni srid pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni srid pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ srid pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de srid pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ skye ba ni skye bas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni skye ba ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ skye ba'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de skye ba ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rga shi ni rga shis stong ste/gang stong pa de ni rga shi ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ rga shi'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de rga shi ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ sbyin pa'i 17—464

pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/gang stong pa de ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin te/ skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol 17—465

tu phyin pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni nang stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ nang stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de nang stong pa nyid ma yin no / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ phyi stong pa nyid ni phyi stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni phyi stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de phyi stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/phyi nang stong pa nyid ni phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni phyi nang stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de phyi nang stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ma yin te/ skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ chen po stong pa nyid ni chen po stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni chen po stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de chen po stong pa 17—466
