nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ni don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni don dam pa stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de don dam pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de 'dus byas stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'dus ma byas she stong pa nyid ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma yin te/ skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/gang stong pa de ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang 17—467

yin pa de thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de chos thams cad stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa 17—468

gang yin pa de myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/yang dag par spong ba rnams ni yang dag par spong ba rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni yang dag par spong ba rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan 17—469

pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de yang dag par spong ba rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ dbang po rnams ni dbang po rnams kyis stong ste/gang stong pa de ni dbang po rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ dbang po rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de dbang po rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ stobs rnams ni stobs rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni stobs rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/stobs rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de stobs rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni phya'aphags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad 17—470

pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ bsam gtan rnams ni bsam gtan rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni bsam gtan rnams ma yin te/ skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na / bsam gtan rnams kyi 〉snam skyes pa gang yin pa de bsam gtan rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ tshad myed pa rnams ni tshad myed pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni tshad myed pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de tshad myed pa rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par thar pa rnams ni rnam par thar pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rnam par thar pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs 17—471

des na/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi phyam skyes pa gang yin pa de rnam par thar pa rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pas stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ mngon par shes pa rnams ni mngon par shes pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni mngon par shes pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de mngon par shes pa rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ⑤ni ting nge 'dzin rnams ma yin te/ skye ba myed 17—472

dol/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de ting nge 'dzin rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong ste / gang stong pa de ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de gzungs kyi sgo rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/myi 'jigs pa rnams ni myi 'jigs pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni myi 'jigs pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de myi 'jigs pa rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byams pa chen po ni byams pa chen pos stong ste/gang stong pa de ni byams pa chen po ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha 17—473

ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ byams pa chen po'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de byams pa chen po ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ snying rje chen po ni snying rje chen pos stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni snying rje chen po ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ snying rje chen po'i ma skyes pa gang yin pa de snying rje chen po ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ thams cad shes pa nyid ni thams cad shes pa nyid kyis stong ste/gang stong pa de ni thams cad shes pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de thams cad shes pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis stong ste/gang stong pa de ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi ma skyes pa gang yin pa de lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis stong ste/ gang stong pa de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin te skye ba myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ rnam grangs des na/17—474

phyi nang stong pa nyid ma yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ma yin/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ chen po stong pa nyid ma yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid ma yin/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi 17'grib pa gang yin pa de ni / mtha' las 'das pa sto nga pa nyid ma yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa rgyastong pa nyid ma yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid ma yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ range gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ma yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma yin/ yang 17—478

dag par spong ba rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ yang dag par spong ba rnams ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ma yin/ dbang po rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni / dbang po rnams ma yin/ stobs rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/stobs rnams ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ma yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi 'grib pa chogang yin pa de ni/'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ma yin/ bsam gtan rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ bsam gtan rnams ma yin/ tshad skyed pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ tshad myed pa rnams ma yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa rnams ma yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ma yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ting nge 'dzin rnams ma yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de 17—479

ni / gzungs kyi sgo rnams ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ma yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ myi 'jigs pa rnams ma yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ma yin/ byams pa chen po'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ byams pa chen po ma yin/ snying rje chen po'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ snying rje chen po ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ma yin/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni nyu / thams cad shes pa nyid ma yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ma yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin zhes zerargya// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu bzhi ②pa/rab 'byor kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ 'di ltar 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / gzugs gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / tshor ba gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / 'du shes gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / 'du byed gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rnam par shes pa gang yin pa 17—480

dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / myig gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rna ba gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / sna gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / lce gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / lus gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / yid gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ste/'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / gzugs gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / sgra gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / dri gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / ro gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / reg gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / chos gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin/ myi 17—481

ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ste/'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin/ myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa ①dang / 'grib 17—482

pa gang yin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin/ myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa stekhya/'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin/ myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /'grib pa gang yin pa dang /sa'i khams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / chu'i khams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / mye'i khams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin 17—483

pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rga shi gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ste/'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa nyudang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ste/'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa ②gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /17—485

gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang 17—486

yin pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin / myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ①ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / dran pa nye ②bar gzhag pa rnams gang yin pa dang /gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang /dbang po rnams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / stobs rnams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / bsam gtan rnams gang yin pa dang / gnyiso su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang /tshad myed pa rnams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang 17—487

gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin/ myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o / /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rang byang chub gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs myed pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o / /'grib pa gang yin pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su byar myed pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang ldan pa yang ma yin myi ldan pa yang ma yin/ ci gzugs med pa bltar myed pa thogs pa myed pa ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/rnam grangs des na/ gzugs kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang ①gzugs ma yin/tshor ba'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang tshor ba ma yin/ 'du shes kyi 'grib pa 17—489

de yang mying dang gzugs ma yin/ skye mched drug gi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang skye mched drug ma yin/ reg pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang reg pa ma yin / tshor ba'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang tshor ba ma yin/ sred pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang srid pa ma yin/ len pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang len pa ma yin/ srid pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang srid pa ma yin/skye ba'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang skye ba ma yin/ rga shi'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang rga shi ma yin/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ nang stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang nang stong pa nyid ma yin/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang phyi stong pa nyid ma yin / phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang phyi nang stong pa nyid ma yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang stong pa nyid ①stong pa nyid ma yin/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang chen po stong pa nyid ma yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang don dam pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang 17—492

yin pa de yang 'dus byas stong pa nyid ma yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ma yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid ma yin/chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang chos thams cad stong pa nyid ma yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ma yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ma yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ma yin / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma yin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang yang dag par spong ba rnams ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi 'grib pa ①gang yin pa de yang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ma yin/ dbang po rnams ②kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang dbang po rnams ma yin/ stobs rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang stobs rnams ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi 17—493

'grib pa gang yin pa de yang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ma yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ma yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ma yin/ bsam gtan rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang bsam gtan rnams ma yin/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang tshad myed pa rnams ma yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang rnam par thar pa rnams ma yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ma yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ma yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang mngon par shes pa rnams ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang ting nge 'dzin rnams ma yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang gzungs kyi sgo rnams ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ma yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang myi 'jigs pa rnams ma yin/so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ma yin/ byams pa chen po'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de yang 17—494

gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di ①sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su ②skyed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di phyi stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o / /gang 'di stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di chen po stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su phyed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di 'dus byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di rang bzhin 17—498

stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di chos thams cad stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di rang gi mtshan nyid ⑨stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams zhes bya ba de ②ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di yang dag par spong ba rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di dbang po rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di stobs rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di byang chub kyi yan lag rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di bsam gtan rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di tshad myed pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su 17—499

myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di rnam par thar pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o//gang 'di rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa myed pa zhes ①bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di mngon par shes pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa'o / /gang 'di ting nge 'dzin rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di gzungs kyi sgo rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su skyed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di myi 'jigs pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di so so yang dag par rig pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o / /gang 'di byams pa chen po zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di snying rje chen po zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di thams cad shes pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di lam gyi rnam pa ②shes pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /gang 'di rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o zhes zer/ /rab 'byor kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu / 'di ltar gzugs kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/17—500

ma skyes pa nyid kyang gzugs/ gzugs nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di gzugs zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar tshor ba yang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang tshor ba/ tshor ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di tshor ba zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar 'du shes kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang 'du shes/ 'du shes nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di 'du shes zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar 'du byed kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang 'du byed/ 'du byed nyid kyang ma skyes pa ①ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di 'du byed ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ma skyes pa nyid kyang rnam par shes pa/ rnam par shes pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar myig kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang myig/myig nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di myig ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rna ba yang gzhan ②ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa 17—501

nyid kyang rna ba/ rna ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rna ba zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar sna yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang sna/ sna nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di sna zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar lce yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang lce/ lce nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di lce zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar lus kyang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang lus/ lus nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di lus zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar yid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang yid / yid nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di yid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o / /'di ltar gzugs kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang gzugs/ gzugs nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di gzugs zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar sgra yang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang sgra/ sgra nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di sgra 17—502

zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar dri yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang dri/dri nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di dri zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar ro yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang ro/ ro nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di ro zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o / /'di ltar reg kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ma skyes pa nyid kyang reg /reg nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di reg ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar chos kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang chos/ chos nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di chos zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar myig gi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang myig gi rnam par shes pa/ myig gi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di myig gi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ma skyes pa nyid kyang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 17—503

'di rna ba'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o / /'di ltar sna'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin①/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang sna'i rnam par shes pa/ sna'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na / gang 'di sna'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar lce'i rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang lce'i rnam par shes pa/ lce'i rnam par shes pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di lce'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang lus kyi rnam par shes pa/lus kyi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di lus kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te②/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di yid kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang myig gi 'dus te reg pa/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di myig gi 17—504

'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te / ma skyes pa nyid kyang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang sna'i 'dus te reg pa sna'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na / gang 'di sna'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang lce'i 'dus te reg pa/ lalce'i 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di lce'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa/lus kyi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di lus kyi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di yid kyi 'dus te reg pa 17—505

zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba/myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa stel/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma yin / ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed 17—506

pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba/ lus kyi 'dus ①te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar sa'i khams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang sa'i khams sa'i khams nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di sa'i khams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar chu'i khams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang chu'i khams chu'i khams nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di chu'i khams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar mye'i khams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang mye'i khams me'i khams nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di me'i khams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su 17—507

myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rlung gi khams kyang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rlung gi khams rlung gi khams nyid kyang ma skyes pa stel/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rlung gi khams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar nam mkha'i khams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma ②yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang nam mkha'i khams nam mkha'i khams nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di nam mkha'i khams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o//'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'i khams/ rnam par shes pa'i khams nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rnam par shes pa'i khams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar ma rig pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang ma rig pa/ ma rig pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di ma rig pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar 'du byed kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang 'du byed/ 'du byed nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di 'du byed ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rnam par shes pa/17—508

rnam par shes pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar mying dang gzugs kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang mying dang gzugs/ mying dang gzugs nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di mying dang gzugs zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar skye mched drug kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang skye mched drug /skye mched drug nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di skye mched drug ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar reg pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang reg pa reg pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di reg pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar tshor ba yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang tshor ba tshor ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di tshor ba zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar sred pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang sred pa/srid pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na / gang 'di sred pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar len pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma 17wa 509

skyes pa nyid kyang len pa/ len pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di len pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar srid pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang srid pa/ srid pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di srid pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar skye ba yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang skye ba/ skye ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di skye ba zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rga shi yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rga shi/ rga shi nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rga shi zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa ①nyid kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ sbyin pa'i pha ②rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni 17—510

gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ya nga gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na / gang 'di bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bco lnga ①pa/'di ltar nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/17—511

ma skyes pa nyid kyang nang stong pa nyid/ nang stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang phyi stong pa nyid/ phyi stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di phyi stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin / ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid / phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin / ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar chen po stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang chen po stong pa nyid/ chen po stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di chen po stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe 17—512

dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang 'dus byas stong pa nyid/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di 'dus byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ①ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes 17—513

pa nyid kyang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di dor ba med pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o//'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di rang bzhin 37stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di chos thams cad stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o / /'di ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang 17—514

gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ma skyes pa nyid kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang yang dag par spong ba rnams/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di yang dag par 17—515

spong ba rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar dbang po rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang dbang po rnams/ dbang po rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di dbang po rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar stobs rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ma skyes pa nyid kyang stobs rnams/ stobs rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di stobs rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di byang chub kyi yan lag rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa nyid kyang ①ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di 'phags pa'i lam yan 17—516

lag brgyad pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar bsam gtan rnams kyang gzhan ma yin / ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang bsam gtan rnams / bsam gtan rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di bsam gtan rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar tshad myed pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang tshad med pa rnams/ tshad med pa rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di tshad myed pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ma skyes pa nyid kyang gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rnam par thar pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ma skyes pa nyid kyang rnam par thar pa rnams/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyang ma 17—517

skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rnam par thar pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ma skyes pa nyid kyang mngon par shes pa rnams/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di mngon par shes pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang ting nge 'dzin rnams/ ting nge 'dzin rnams 17—518

kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di ting nge 'dzin rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang gzungs kyi sgo rnams/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di gzungs kyi sgo rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar mi 'jigs pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang myi 'jigs pa rnams①/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di myi 'jigs pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ma skyes pa nyid kyang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di so so yang dag par rig pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar byams pa chen po yang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang byams pa chen po/17—519

byams pa chen po nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di byams pa chen po zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar snying rje chen po yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang snying rje chen po/ snying rje chen po nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di snying rje chen po zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ①kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes 17—520

pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu/phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar dgra bcom pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang dgra bcom pa nyid/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di dgra bcom pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rang byang chub kyang gzhan ma yin / ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rang byang chub/rang byang chub nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di rang byang chub ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang 'di lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ /'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ ma skyes pa nyid kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang ma skyes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam grangs des na/gang 'di rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su myed pa'i grangs su byas pa'o/ / de nas ①tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis bcom ldan 17—521

'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gi ①tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing /chos de dag la de ltar yongs su rtog pa de'i tshe/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ gzugs kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ tshor ba'i ldum skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ 'du shes kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ 'du byed kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ myig gi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ rna ba'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ sna'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ lce'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ lus kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ yid kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ gzugs kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ sgra'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ dri'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ ro'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ reg gi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ chos kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ myig gi rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/17—522

shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ rna ba'i 'dus te rig pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ yid kyi 17—523

'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ sa'i khams kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ chu'i khams kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ mye'i khams kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ rlung gi khams kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ nam mkha'i khams kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ma rig pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/'du byed kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ ming dang gzugs kyi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ skye mched drug gi ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ reg pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ tshor ba'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ sred pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ len pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ srid pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ skye ba'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ rga shi'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i ma skyes pa mthong bar 17—524
